nodes.description: Public address storing the governance account, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the onlyGov authority and rescue recipient.
Mapping(address=>bool) flagging accounts allowed to call distributeRewards through the onlyFundManager modifier.
Caller-controlled address used to set governance, to authorize modifiers, and emitted in DistributedReward.
Sets governance to msg.sender and registers each address in _fundManagers as a fund manager.
Governance-only function that sets fundManager[_address] to true.
Governance-only function that sets fundManager[_address] to false.
Governance-only function that transfers the contract's whole balance of _rewardToken to governance.
Fund-manager-only loop that transfers reward tokens to recipients and then notifies each recipient contract.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == governance, otherwise reverting with !governance.
Modifier requiring fundManager[msg.sender] == true, otherwise reverting with !manager.
External IERC20.safeTransfer of the full token balance from this contract to governance.
External ERC20 safeTransfer of amount to the recipient address inside the distributeRewards loop.
External call to attacker-supplied recipient.notifyRewardAmount performed after the token transfer, enabling reentrancy/callback.
Constructor array parameter of initial fund manager addresses.
Address parameter of addFundManager to be granted fund manager rights.
Address parameter of removeFundManager to be stripped of fund manager rights.
ERC20 token address whose full balance is rescued to governance.
Calldata array of recipient contracts implementing IRewardsDistributionRecipient.
Calldata array of ERC20 reward token addresses.
Calldata array of reward amounts matching the token and recipient arrays.
Loop index used to iterate over _fundManagers in the constructor.
Local variable holding the contract's balance of the reward token before rescuing.
Local length of the recipients array, validated against token and amount array lengths.
Loop index used to iterate over recipients, tokens and amounts.
Local reward amount taken from _amounts[i] and used in the transfer and notification.
Local ERC20 token reference taken from _rewardTokens[i].
Local recipient contract reference taken from _recipients[i] that receives token and callback.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the untrusted msg.sender into the governance state variable, making the deployer the sole privileged account.
distributeRewards emits msg.sender as the funder in the DistributedReward event.
onlyGov compares the untrusted msg.sender against governance to authorize privileged functions.
onlyFundManager looks up fundManager[msg.sender] to authorize reward distribution.
The onlyGov modifier reads the governance state variable for its authorization check.
The onlyFundManager modifier reads the fundManager mapping for its authorization check.
The _fundManagers array parameter drives the constructor's registration loop.
The constructor loop index indexes _fundManagers and writes true into the fundManager mapping.
addFundManager uses its _address parameter as the input to be authorized.
addFundManager writes true at fundManager[_address].
removeFundManager uses its _address parameter as the key to revoke.
removeFundManager writes false at fundManager[_address].
rescue uses the caller-supplied _rewardToken address to query and transfer a token balance.
The _rewardToken parameter is the ERC20 target of the rescue safeTransfer.
The local _balance holds the queried token balance that is passed as the transfer value.
governance is the fixed recipient of the rescued token balance.
_recipients supplies the recipient contracts iterated in distributeRewards.
_rewardTokens supplies the ERC20 addresses iterated in distributeRewards.
_amounts supplies the transfer values iterated in distributeRewards.
The length of _recipients is stored in the local len variable.
The validated len value bounds the distribution loop index.
The loop index selects the current amount from _amounts.
_amounts[i] is read into the local amount used for the transfer.
The local amount is the value passed to safeTransfer in the distribution loop.
The local rewardToken is the ERC20 on which safeTransfer is invoked.
The local recipient address is the destination of the reward token transfer.
The transferred amount is passed on to recipient.notifyRewardAmount.
The reward token address is passed to recipient.notifyRewardAmount.
addFundManager is guarded by the onlyGov modifier.
removeFundManager is guarded by the onlyGov modifier.
rescue is guarded by the onlyGov modifier.
distributeRewards is guarded by the onlyFundManager modifier.
rescue executes the safeTransfer of the full token balance to governance.
distributeRewards executes the reward token transfer inside its loop.
The external token transfer is performed before the external notification call, so state/notification follows the transfer without a reentrancy guard.
distributeRewards invokes an arbitrary recipient contract callback each iteration.
The caller-supplied recipient contract is called back via notifyRewardAmount, giving external code control flow after funds are sent.

normalization_plan.reason: The _fundManagers array parameter only feeds the constructor and is absorbed into it.
The _address parameter is exclusively the input of addFundManager.
The _address parameter is exclusively the input of removeFundManager.
The _rewardToken parameter is exclusively the input of rescue.
The _recipients array parameter is only consumed by the distributeRewards loop.
The _rewardTokens array parameter is only consumed by the distributeRewards loop.
The _amounts array parameter is only consumed by the distributeRewards loop.
The constructor loop index exists only within the constructor's registration loop.
The _balance local exists solely to feed the rescue safeTransfer.
The len local is a derived length check confined to distributeRewards.
The loop index is scoped to the distributeRewards loop.
The amount local is the direct value argument of the reward safeTransfer.
The rewardToken local is the ERC20 target of the reward safeTransfer.
The recipient local is the contract invoked by the notifyRewardAmount callback.
